description.narrative: The London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE) is a renowned university that was founded in 1895 and specializes in social sciences. It is the most international university in the world, with its 12,000 students and 1,800 academics coming from 148 countries and more than 100 languages spoken on campus. The university’s mission is to ensure that through research; the graduates it shapes; and collaborations locally, nationally, and globally, LSE is a leading social science institution with great global impact.
